description: F1 of each model when it accepts its top-k candidates, k/437 from 1% to 100%; three-checkpoint ensemble scores from rows.csv (Figure 2).
tie_handling: rows.csv rounds scores to 6 decimals: ties in sentence (2 groups of 2), triple (4 groups), none in pair; inside a tied group TP is its expected value under random order. Cross-checks: stable sort, and full-precision S_biodiv_*.npy.
